technical_rewrite.original: Define a Fabric ontology in plain language. It's a shared model of the things the business cares about, what we know about them, how they connect, and where the supporting data lives. A Store is an entity type. A particular store is an instance. Region and priority are properties. “Store operates Refrigeration Unit” is a relationship. A data binding connects those concepts to actual source fields. We can also attach business rules and metrics. That lets a question refer to an established concept instead of asking every consumer to reconstruct its meaning from table names.
